title: Worker-only execution and sealed results
summary: An authorized run is revalidated immediately before worker start; the worker then seals outcome/evidence metadata after execution.
invariants: workerStart requires AUTHORIZED state and checks expiry/material fingerprint.
There is no QUALIFICATION.EXECUTE dispatch operation.
workerSeal is bound to the worker that started the run.
Results are QUALIFIED, FAILED or INCONCLUSIVE and carry an evidence-manifest hash plus result-set hash.
